mapper.sql: SELECT u.id, CASE WHEN u.event_id IS NULL THEN CONCAT('0:',LPAD(u.id,20,'0')) ELSE CONCAT('1:',u.event_id) END AS event_cursor, COALESCE(u.request_started_at,u.create_time) AS request_started_at, u.request_id, u.tenant_id, u.user_id, u.api_key_id, COALESCE(a.service_id,u.service_id) AS service_id, u.model, u.status, u.usage_source, COALESCE(u.input_tokens,u.prompt_tokens,0) AS input_tokens, COALESCE(u.output_tokens,u.completion_tokens,0) AS output_tokens, COALESCE(u.normalized_total_tokens,u.total_tokens,0) AS total_tokens, CASE WHEN a.id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(raw.cost_status,u.cost_status) ELSE a.cost_status END AS cost_status, CASE WHEN a.id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(raw.estimated_cost_fen,u.estimated_cost_fen) ELSE a.cost_fen END AS estimated_cost_fen, CASE WHEN a.id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(raw.currency,u.currency) ELSE 'CNY' END AS currency FROM t_token_usage u LEFT JOIN t_token_usage_cost raw ON raw.usage_id=u.id LEFT JOIN t_cost_reconciliation_case c ON c.event_id=u.event_id AND c.tenant_id=u.tenant_id AND c.request_id=u.request_id AND c.source=u.source LEFT JOIN t_cost_reconciliation_adjustment a ON a.case_id=c.id AND a.version=( SELECT latest.version FROM t_cost_reconciliation_adjustment latest WHERE latest.case_id=c.id ORDER BY latest.version DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.source='API_KEY' AND COALESCE(u.request_started_at,u.create_time) >= #{from} AND COALESCE(u.request_started_at,u.create_time) < #{to} AND u.user_id=#{userId} AND u.api_key_id=#{apiKeyId} AND COALESCE(a.service_id,u.service_id)=#{serviceId} UNION ALL SELECT NULL,CONCAT('1:',c.event_id),c.request_started_at,c.request_id,c.tenant_id,COALESCE(owner.user_id,0),c.api_key_id,a.service_id, COALESCE(model.model_name,CAST(a.service_id AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci), 'RECONCILED','UNKNOWN',NULL,NULL,NULL,a.cost_status,a.cost_fen,'CNY' FROM t_cost_reconciliation_case c JOIN t_cost_reconciliation_adjustment a ON a.case_id=c.id AND a.version=( SELECT latest.version FROM t_cost_reconciliation_adjustment latest WHERE latest.case_id=c.id ORDER BY latest.version DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN t_llm_service model ON model.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND model.service_id=a.service_id LEFT JOIN t_user owner ON owner.user_id=c.user_id AND owner.status<>2 AND owner.del_flag=0 WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.source='API_KEY' AND c.request_started_at >= #{from} AND c.request_started_at < #{to} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_token_usage u WHERE u.event_id=c.event_id AND u.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND u.request_id=c.request_id AND u.source=c.source ) AND owner.user_id=#{userId} AND c.api_key_id=#{apiKeyId} AND a.service_id=#{serviceId}
